groups.definition: Restructuring or footprint changes may require significant charges, capex and impairments and may fail to deliver expected benefits.

groups.canonical_name: China joint venture competition and impairments
groups.definition: Intensifying domestic competition in China erodes joint venture results, leading to impairments, equity losses and restructuring charges.
Low-cost Chinese and Indian manufacturers compete in emerging and established markets, pressuring pricing and market share.
Significant goodwill and acquired intangibles may become impaired, resulting in material non-cash charges to earnings.
